name: Bank Loan
text: When performing an Acquire Assets action, you may gain a Debt Condition to immediately add 2 successes to your test result.
flavor: Sign on the dotted line.

name: .38 Revolver
text: Gain +2 Strength during Combat Encounters.
flavor: Standard issue and dependable.

name: .45 Automatic
text: Gain +3 Strength during Combat Encounters.

name: .18 Derringer
text: You may add 1 to the result of 1 die when resolving a Strength test during a Combat Encounter.
flavor: Small enough to hide in a sleeve.

name: Double-barreled Shotgun
text: Gain +4 Strength during Combat Encounters. Each 6 you roll when resolving a Strength test during a Combat Encounter counts as 2 successes.
flavor: Two barrels of stopping power.

name: Carbine Rifle
text: Once per round, you may gain +5 Strength during a Combat Encounter.
flavor: Steady your aim and squeeze.

name: Spirit Dagger
text: Gain +1 Will and +2 Strength during Combat Encounters.
flavor: Etched with signs that ward the mind and strike the unseen.

name: Bull Whip
text: Gain +1 Strength during Combat Encounters. You may reroll 1 die when resolving a Strength test during a Combat Encounter.
flavor: Keeps beasts at a respectful distance.

rerolls.text: Reroll 1 die on a Strength test in Combat.

name: Fishing Net
text: You may reroll 1 die when resolving a Strength test during a Combat Encounter. Reduce the damage of Monsters you encounter by 1 to a minimum of 1.
flavor: Weighted with lead sinkers and knotted by an old sailor.

rerolls.text: Reroll 1 die on a Strength test in Combat.

name: Dynamite
text: Action: You may discard this card to cause each Monster on your space to lose 3 Health.
flavor: Light the fuse and get clear.

action.text: Discard Dynamite: each Monster on your space loses 3 Health.

name: Kerosene
text: You may discard this card to gain +5 Strength during a Combat Encounter.
flavor: Soak the floor and strike a match.

action.text: Discard Kerosene: each Monster on your space loses 2 Health.

name: Holy Water
text: You may discard this card to gain +5 Will and +5 Strength during a Combat Encounter. Action: You may discard this card to choose an investigator on your space. That investigator gains a Blessed Condition.
flavor: Consecrated in an old cathedral.

action.text: Discard Holy Water: an investigator on your space gains a Blessed Condition.

name: Holy Cross
text: Gain +2 Will during Combat Encounters.
flavor: Worn silver that steadies the heart.

name: Protective Amulet
text: Gain +1 Will during Combat Encounters.
flavor: Carved soapstone on a leather cord.

name: King James Bible
text: You may reroll 1 die when resolving a Will test during a Combat Encounter. When you perform a Rest action, recover 1 additional Sanity.
flavor: Well-thumbed pages of verse.

name: Arcane Tome
text: Gain +2 Lore when resolving Spell effects. When you perform a Rest action, you may test Lore. If you pass, gain 1 Spell.
flavor: The margins are filled with cramped notes.

action.text: Study the tome: test Lore (-1). If you pass, gain 1 Spell.

name: Arcane Manuscripts
text: Gain +1 Lore when resolving Spell effects.
flavor: Loose leaves copied from an older codex.

action.text: Read the manuscripts: discard this card to gain 1 Spell.

name: Puzzle Box
text: When you perform a Rest action, you may attempt to open the puzzle box (Observation-2). If you pass, you may discard this card to gain 1 Artifact.
flavor: Brass plates slide in interlocking grooves.

action.text: Solve the box: test Observation (-1). If you pass, discard this card and gain 1 Artifact.

name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
text: Once per round, you may reroll 1 die when resolving a test.
flavor: A small charm for dark times.

name: Lucky Cigarette Case
text: Once per round, you may add 1 to the result of 1 die when resolving a test.
flavor: Dented by a stray bullet in 1918.

action.text: Discard Lucky Cigarette Case to gain 1 Clue.

name: Pocket Watch
text: You cannot become Delayed unless you choose to.
flavor: Ticks steadily even when the air stands still.

name: Whiskey
text: You may discard this card to prevent an investigator on your space from losing up to 2 Sanity.
flavor: Liquid courage.

action.text: Discard Whiskey: an investigator on your space recovers 2 Sanity.

name: Bandages
text: You may discard this card to prevent an investigator on your space from losing up to 2 Health.
flavor: Clean linen and antiseptic.

action.text: Discard Bandages: an investigator on your space recovers 2 Health.

name: Fine Clothes
text: Each 6 you roll when performing an Acquire Assets action counts as 2 successes.
flavor: Tailored in Savile Row.

name: Arcane Scholar
text: Gain +1 Lore. You may reroll 1 die when resolving a Lore test.
flavor: He reads dead languages faster than English.

rerolls.text: Reroll 1 die on a Lore test.

name: Hired Muscle
text: Gain +1 Strength. You may reroll 1 die when resolving a Strength test.
flavor: Paid by the week and asks no questions.

rerolls.text: Reroll 1 die on a Strength test.

name: Personal Assistant
text: Gain +1 Influence. You may reroll 1 die when resolving a Influence test.
flavor: Keeps your appointments and your secrets.

rerolls.text: Reroll 1 die on an Influence test.

name: Private Investigator
text: Gain +1 Observation. You may reroll 1 die when resolving a Observation test.
flavor: Knows every back alley and hotel clerk.

rerolls.text: Reroll 1 die on an Observation test.

name: Silver Twilight Researcher
text: If you defeat a Monster during a Combat Encounter, recover 1 Sanity and gain 1 Clue.
flavor: Privileged access to the Lodge vaults.

action.text: Consult the researcher: test Lore. If you pass, gain 1 Clue.

name: Cat Burglar
text: Action: Roll 1 die. On a 5 or 6, gain 1 Item or Trinket Asset from the reserve. On a 1, discard this card.
flavor: Locks are only suggestions.

action.text: Send the Cat Burglar: test Observation. If you pass, take 1 Asset from the reserve.

name: Agency Quarantine
text: When you gain this card, immediately choose a space. Each Monster on the chosen space loses 4 Health. Then discard this card.
flavor: Cordons, searchlights, and heavy ordnance.

name: Charter Flight
text: When you gain this card, immediately move up to 2 spaces. Then discard this card.
flavor: A twin-engine biplane waiting on the tarmac.

name: Private Care
text: When you gain this card, immediately recover all Health and Sanity. Then discard this card.
flavor: Discreet physicians and quiet rooms.

name: Delivery Service
text: When you gain this card, immediately give any number of Item possessions to another investigator on any space. Then discard this card.
flavor: Express parcel from Arkham.

name: Sanctuary
text: When you gain this card, you may immediately discard 1 Condition. Then discard this card.
flavor: Candlelight behind stained glass.
